## Description

Utilizes quantum amplitude estimation and parameterized quantum circuits to encode complex multi-asset probability distributions for accelerated Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall calculation.

## Where it may fit

Large-scale portfolio risk management, real-time tail-risk calculation during high volatility.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Risk Groups, Advanced Derivative Desks.

## Required data

Historical asset return covariance matrices, portfolio position weights.

## Caveats

Requires quantum circuit simulation or QPU access; gate depth limitations restrict large asset dimensions on current hardware.
